ai.overallExplanation: The summary incorrectly says the customer refused an I&E assessment. The customer declined to complete it while at work but agreed to do it the following evening.

findings.summaryClaim: The customer refused an I&E assessment scheduled for 21 October after 6 pm

transcriptEvidence.quote: I can do it tomorrow evening when I've got my bank app and the bills in front of me.
Get the bills ready, speak after six tomorrow, and work out what I can actually pay.

findings.explanation: The customer did not refuse the assessment; they said they could not do it at that moment and agreed to complete it the next evening. Calling this a refusal could mislead a colleague about the customer's willingness to engage.
findings.suggestedCorrection: The customer agreed to complete an I&E assessment after 6 pm on 21 October.

ai.suggestedSummary: DPA completed. The company called and reached the customer; arrears were discussed. Overtime, normally adding about £300 a month, has been stopped until Christmas, reducing the customer's income, and the customer said they could not pay today. The agent attempted to secure payment, but the customer declined; no amount was agreed. The customer agreed to complete an I&E assessment after 6 pm on 21 October and prepare income and essential expense details; potential credit-file impact was explained, and the agent checked the customer's understanding.
